subject: A way to turn off spell-checking or to add function names etc. to the dictionary?

messages.author: 0dd6c9694b3c4809
messages.subject: A way to turn off spell-checking or to add function names etc. to the dictionary?
parts:
Hi,
I get that hunspell checking can be valuable.
But without a way to add to the dictionary, this gives me a list of 200+ occasions of words it doesn't know.
Is there a way to:

1. Turn off spell-check
2. Add words to a local dictionary?
